containers.name: test
command:
set -eu
ROOT=<scratch>
ROOTOLD=<scratch>
grep -q '^FINAL_EXIT=0$' "$ROOT/logs/summary.log"
export PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:/usr/local/rustup/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export CARGO_HOME=<scratch> CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$ROOT/target" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 TMPDIR=<scratch>
cd "$ROOT/source"
status=0
run() { name=$1; shift; echo "COMMAND: $*" > "$ROOT/logs/$name.log"; if "$@" >> "$ROOT/logs/$name.log" 2>&1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; echo "SUITE=$name EXIT=$rc"; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then tail -n 100 "$ROOT/logs/$name.log"; status=$rc; else grep 'test result:' "$ROOT/logs/$name.log" || true; fi; }
run lean-typed-default cargo test --locked --offline --test codec --test btree_reuse -- --test-threads=1
run lean-kernel-default cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support --test law1_heap --test law2_shape --test corruption_bounds --test durability --test platform_invariant --test compact_cell_bounds -- --test-threads=1
run lean-io-default cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support --lib io::tests -- --test-threads=1
run lean-packing-default cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support --lib neighbor_capacity_tests -- --test-threads=1
run lean-typed-compact cargo test --locked --offline --features compact-cells,sqlite-balance --test codec --test btree_reuse -- --test-threads=1
run lean-kernel-compact cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support,compact-cells,sqlite-balance --test law1_heap --test law2_shape --test corruption_bounds --test durability --test platform_invariant --test compact_cell_bounds -- --test-threads=1
run lean-io-compact cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support,compact-cells,sqlite-balance --lib io::tests -- --test-threads=1
run lean-packing-compact cargo test --locked --offline -p kernel --features test-support,compact-cells,sqlite-balance --lib neighbor_capacity_tests -- --test-threads=1
printf 'LEAN_EXIT=%s\n' "$status" | tee "$ROOT/logs/lean-summary.log"
cd "$ROOT"
find source -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > logs/all-source-sha256.log
cp "$ROOTOLD/logs/fixture-sha256.log" logs/old-fixture-sha256.log
cp "$ROOTOLD/logs/archive-sha256.log" logs/old-fixture-archive-sha256.log
cp "$ROOTOLD/logs/binary-sha256.log" logs/old-helper-binary-sha256.log
find logs -type f -print > evidence-files.txt
find smoke-off smoke-on bench-1m-off bench-1m-on -type f \( -name results.json -o -name REPORT.md -o -name e4.json -o -name sqlite.json \) -print >> evidence-files.txt
sha256sum source.tar.gz > logs/source-archive-sha256.log
echo logs/source-archive-sha256.log >> evidence-files.txt
tar -czf evidence.tar.gz -T evidence-files.txt
sha256sum evidence.tar.gz > evidence-sha256.txt
cat evidence-sha256.txt
echo EVIDENCE_READY
exit "$status"
